Depart from Gamboa for a boat excursion on Gatun Lake, one of the world's largest artificial lakes and part of the Panama Canal waterway.

From the boat, watch ships passing through the canal and take in the surrounding tropical forest. The route then continues to Monkey Island, where you may encounter several species of monkeys and other animals in their natural habitat.

This excursion combines wildlife watching with views of the forested shores and an introduction to the Panama Canal ecosystem. On tour P036, the group returns to Panama City after the excursion. Animal sightings depend on local conditions.

## Three ways to discover Geisha coffee

We arrange a one-hour tasting of 3 Geisha coffees with different processing methods for your group. Your host will explain the history and origins of Panamanian coffee and how processing affects its aroma and flavor. We serve specially selected desserts alongside the coffee.

For corporate trips to Panama, we combine the tasting with lunch and a walk through Casco Viejo. We will agree on the venue and language when you book.

The boat journey takes you across waters in extraordinarily vivid shades of blue and turquoise. Wind and water have shaped the marble cliffs into unusual arches, grottoes and columns. Sunlight passing beneath the stone vaults reflects off the water, creating an ever-changing play of colors.

The Marble Caves are considered one of Patagonia's major natural attractions. After the excursion, return to the lodge.

This full-day excursion takes place aboard the Maria Turquesa yacht on Lake Argentino. Departure is from the private port of La Soledad, approximately 60 km from El Calafate. The Patagonian Ice Field is considered the largest on the planet after Antarctica, so the excursion centers on an extended journey through the glaciers and channels of the national park.

The route visits glaciers within the national park. There is a landing and walk at Puesto de Las Vacas, followed by sailing through the channels of the Upsala and Perito Moreno glaciers.

A boxed lunch is served on board: a lamb sandwich with a side dish, dessert and a soft drink. After returning, transfer to the hotel.

You can choose Glaciares Gourmet Premium for an additional $153. This option includes an expanded meal with an appetizer, first course, main course, dessert, alcoholic and nonalcoholic drinks.
